segments.an3.48:1.1: “Himavantaṃ, bhikkhave, pabbatarājaṃ nissāya mahāsālā tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhanti.
segments.an3.48:1.3: Sākhāpattapalāsena vaḍḍhanti, tacapapaṭikāya vaḍḍhanti, pheggusārena vaḍḍhanti.
segments.an3.48:1.4: Himavantaṃ, bhikkhave, pabbatarājaṃ nissāya mahāsālā imāhi tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhanti.
segments.an3.48:2.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, saddhaṃ kulapatiṃ nissāya anto jano tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhati.
segments.an3.48:2.3: Saddhāya vaḍḍhati, sīlena vaḍḍhati, paññāya vaḍḍhati.
segments.an3.48:2.4: Saddhaṃ, bhikkhave, kulapatiṃ nissāya anto jano imāhi tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhatī”ti.
segments.an3.48:3.3: Taṃ rukkhā upanissāya, vaḍḍhante te vanappatī.
segments.an3.48:4.5: Amaccā ñātisaṅghā ca, ye cassa anujīvino.
segments.an3.48:5.3: Passamānānukubbanti, attamatthaṃ [ye bhavanti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] vicakkhaṇā.

lines: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, maggaṃ sugatigāminanti sugatigāmikamaggasaṅkhātaṃ dhammaṃ caritvā.
Navame idha sāla -saddo rukkhasāmaññapariyāyo, na rukkhavisesapariyāyoti āha “mahāsālāti mahārukkhā”ti.
Gāmaṃ gāmūpacārañca ṭhapetvā sabbaṃ araññanti āha “araññasminti agāmakaṭṭhāne”ti.
